original_value: The Transcend SSD230 SATA III 2.5 6GBs Internal SSD 128GB uses 3D NAND technology which features vertical, stacked expansion of storage cells.It can achieve Read Speeds of up to 560 MBs

result.paraphrase: The Transcend SSD230 is a 2.5-inch SATA III internal SSD with 128GB capacity and 6GBs interface. It uses 3D NAND technology, featuring vertically stacked storage cells, and can reach read speeds of up to 560 MBs.
